evidence: Frozen task/task.toml:5 name = "turing/hireops-recruiting-operations" equals turing/<logical dirname>; the live project directory is projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations, and the assignment states the snapshot dir 'task' is not an identity defect. Org is turing as required for staged tasks. Every template CHANGE_ME/change-me placeholder (template task.toml lines 5-14) is replaced; grep for CHANGE_ME/change-me/colderwater/sibling residue in the frozen task found none. description (task.toml:6) 'Recruiting workspace with a shared pipeline board and recruiter-candidate conversations that stay correct and usable while several people work at once.' names the product's two surfaces and the concurrency axis exactly as instruction.md:1 ('Candidates move across a pipeline board ... recruiters talk to those candidates in a conversation ... Several of us have it open at once'). keywords recruiting/pipeline/messaging/realtime + webdev/turing/full-stack match the template's required trailing three and the brief (instruction.md:5 live updates within fifteen seconds). difficulty = 'hard' is consistent with the scope (43 functional criteria plus 5 polish, 5 visual, 2 gates; concurrency, all-or-nothing bulk moves, undo, paging, drafts, privacy). difficulty_explanation enumerates axes that each appear in the brief/rules: one-step moves, interview capacity, role rules (hireops_rules.md sections 3 'Moving a card', 'Interview places', 'Who may move what'), stale-move refusal naming who (instruction.md:3), all-or-nothing bulk + undo while untouched (instruction.md:3, rules 'Moving several together','Undo'), per-person unread and seen, paged history keeping place, drafts surviving reload and sign-out (instruction.md:7, rules section 6), live updates without disturbing typing/focus/scroll (instruction.md:5,7), candidates never receiving staff-only data (instruction.md:9, rules section 7). category = 'programming' and tags equal the template. provenance names HireOps and the recruiting workspace and quotes no criterion counts (so no count drift possible). arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations' fits the domain. app_context.md:3 'Name: HireOps' and seed jobs (Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer) agree with the same product. [task].version is absent, which is explicitly optional. Minor observation (not a defect against the row text): staged-task-contract.md's comment says description covers 'product, axes of difficulty, judge, dimension policy'; this description states product and axes but not judge/dimension policy. The workbook row and quality-checks.md check 8 require only that it 'names this product and its actual axes', and judge/weights are intentionally held only in [verifier.env] and scoring.toml per the contract fact table, so this is not a failure. Adversarial consideration: this row grades metadata, not app behaviour, so a broken app or a conforming alternative cannot change its outcome; the only way to fail would be stale metadata from a prior candidate (e.g. a removed feature still described) — the frozen description/difficulty_explanation mention nothing absent from the frozen brief or rules.
